meta.title: Disney Spent $15 Billion Buying Three Companies It Didn't Need To Build
meta.hook: Disney did not create Pixar, Marvel, or Star Wars. It spent about fifteen point five billion dollars to own them.
meta.description: Between 2006 and 2012, Disney spent roughly $15.8 billion acquiring Pixar for $7.4 billion, Marvel for $4 billion, and Lucasfilm for $4.05 billion. Rather than building competing franchises from scratch, Disney bet its capital on owning proven ones outright, a strategy that reshaped its film business for the following decade.

scenes.narration: Disney did not create Pixar, Marvel, or Star Wars. It spent about fifteen point five billion dollars to own them.
